sections.zh_tw_rendering_candidate: 歷史記載：Plinius 稱其具強效癒合力。古時視為萬能藥，用於內外傷及骨折。名稱源於根皮顏色或癒合特性。
warnings: Content describes historical medical beliefs, not modern advice.
